propDrawPlane.defect: staging/index.ts `held-by` wrote z = (holder.z ?? 40) + 2 into the compiled object plane, and nothing recomputes a staged plane on release; a prop that STARTS held was drawn over every actor for the whole shot (z 52 > actor 50)
propDrawPlane.evidence: per frame on r1: held frames drawn plane 50 (holder), free frames drawn plane 52 (above the server); a-badminton's control shuttle (staged center, z 35) draws 35 free / 50 held
propDrawPlane.fixed: staging held-by now writes the object's own plane (35); the renderer's PerformanceEpisode propPlane raises it to the holder's plane only while the bake reports a hold, so picked-up and started-held props share one mechanism
